summary: Jefferson County cabin lookout from the 1940s, removed or destroyed in 1956 and registered in 2011. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Cabin removed (Register) or destroyed (FireLookout.com) in 1956; no source describes the site today

events.note: Sources say only 'the 1940s'; 1940 stands in for the decade, not a documented date
Register says removed; FireLookout.com says destroyed
Registered July 16, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: Located on the Deschutes National Forest
Register lists the U.S. Forest Service as administrator
Cabin built in the 1940s and removed in 1956
evidence.quote: Built in the 1940s, this cabin was removed in 1956.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register says the cabin was removed in 1956; FireLookout.com says destroyed in 1956. Both agree on the year; the story reports both words.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two sources, neither gives a year for the cabin beyond the 1940s, and no source describes the site today or its access. Oregon Lookouts has a Jefferson County 'ROUND BUTTE' page with no content beyond the name. Two web searches returned nothing further. The brief's access 'unknown' is left unset because no source supports a level. Search snippets mention Round Butte Overlook Park near Madras (Travel Oregon, Tripadvisor); no source ties that park to this lookout site, so it is not used.
